from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((("h", i) for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep:
        _, k = sep
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
    else:
        j = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
        a = [row[:j] for row in grid]
        b = [row[j+1:] for row in grid]
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    # Shared sparse color is the marked symbol in the two panels.
    common = set(ca) & set(cb)
    color = min(common, key=lambda x: ca[x] + cb[x])
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(a, b):
        out.append([3 if x == color and y == color else color
                    for x, y in zip(ra, rb)])
    return out
